```lean
open CategoryTheory in
theorem lg_target {C : Type*} [Category C] {X Y Z : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) [IsIso f] [IsIso g] : IsIso (f ≫ g) := by
  obtain ⟨f_inv, f_inv_left, f_inv_right⟩ := IsIso.isInverse f
  obtain ⟨g_inv, g_inv_left, g_inv_right⟩ := IsIso.isInverse g
  constructor
  · rw [← f_inv_right, ← g_inv_left]
    exact (g_inv ≫ f_inv).comp_right
  · rw [← f_inv_left, ← g_inv_right]
    exact (g_inv ≫ f_inv).comp_left
```
